videos.title: Switching banquets, spa and laundry on

intro.text: Banquets, the spa and the laundry are switched on hotel by hotel. In this video you will see where, and what staff see while one is off.

line.text: The switches are in Settings, under Modules. Only the owner or an administrator sees this page.
Each line says what it runs. Banquet hall is the diary, the halls and their packages. A hall cannot be sold twice for the same session.
Laundry is a guest's laundry, charged to their room, and the hotel's own linen going out and coming back.
Spa is treatments and the day's diary. Today, every treatment goes on the guest's room bill.
Each one starts off. Tap its switch to turn it on, and its part of the menu appears at once.
While one is off, its part of the menu is not there. A screen opened by its address says it is not available, like this Diary.
Halls and packages says the same. Nothing can be booked or changed, even by typing the address. The server refuses it too.
The message says to turn it on in the property's settings. Only the owner or an administrator can, so ask one of them.

outro.text: Each part starts empty: no hall, no treatment, no price. The next videos show what each one does.

videos.title: Banquets: booking and billing a function

intro.text: This video is for the general manager: a banquet function, from the first call to its bill.

line.text: Here the banquet hall is switched off. Where it is on, Halls and packages is where the hotel's halls and food packages are entered. Nothing is made for you.
The Diary shows each hall over thirty days, with its functions. An empty hall says Free for the whole window.
Tap Register a function: the hall, what it is, from when until when, and the host. Leave the price blank if it is not agreed. It shows a dash.
A new function is an enquiry, and holds nothing. Confirm and hold the hall takes it. If the hall is taken, the message names the function in the way.
Add a course from a package, or off-menu, with the plates and the rate a head. Food from the restaurant is put on the function at the Till.
Confirming opens the function's bill. Take an advance, then Bill the function. It is refused while anything is unpriced, or while the banquet tax is not set.
Then Settle, and Issue tax invoice. The owner, an administrator and the GM take the money. The accountant may also issue the invoice.
To cancel, type why. A billed function cannot be cancelled. Before its invoice, Reopen the bill takes the hall and courses off, with a reason.

outro.text: A hall cannot be sold twice: only a confirmed function holds it.

intro.text: This video is for reception: booking a spa treatment, and putting it on the room bill.

line.text: The spa is switched on in Modules, by the owner or an administrator. At this hotel it is off.
So the Spa diary says it is not available. Where it is on, the diary shows one day, therapist by therapist.
First, on Treatments, the owner, an administrator or the GM enter each treatment, how long it takes, and its price. And each therapist, by name.
To book, move the diary to the day, and tap Book a treatment. Choose the guest, the treatment, the therapist, and the time.
The treatment's length places it in the day. One therapist is never in two places at once: if the time is taken, the message names who is in the way.
Every treatment is for a guest's stay, on a day from their arrival to their departure.
When it is given, tap Charge to room. It goes on the guest's bill as its own line, at the spa's own GST rate. The guest must be checked in.
Price the treatment before you book it. The price is copied when it is booked, and a booking with no price cannot be charged.
To cancel, type why, and the hour is free again. Housekeeping can see the diary, but not book.

outro.text: Settling at the spa itself is not built yet. Every treatment goes on the room bill.

intro.text: This video is for reception and housekeeping: the laundry dockets.

line.text: The laundry is switched on in Modules too. At this hotel it is off.
So Dockets says the laundry is not available. Where it is on, Dockets lists every bag, a guest's and the hotel's own, with what is still out first.
First, the price list: one line for each thing and service, such as a shirt, washed. With no price decided, it reads a dash.
A docket is one bag. Tap Collect a bag, and say first whose it is: a guest's bag, or the hotel's own linen.
A guest's bag names their stay. Only a checked-in guest can hand one in.
Pick each thing from the price list, and how many. The prices are copied onto the docket, so price the list first.
When it comes back, tap Record what came back, and type how many of each have come back in total. When nothing is still out, it marks itself Back.
For a guest's bag, tap Charge to the room. It goes on their bill as its own line, under laundry's own GST rate.
The hotel's own linen is counted out and back, and never charged to anybody. A docket can be cancelled until it is on a bill.

outro.text: Every docket says whose it is, so the hotel's sheets never reach a guest's bill.
